args.text: Can you pull every ticket and feature request on Pellucid Harbor Logistics and Driftmoor Marine Freight from the Coastal channels and Moss's Coastal notes, labelled by account? Leave Pellow Home Living out even though it shares the PHL code. I need the list for Kwame's account review.

Bettina, here's what I found for Kwame's review. Sources: #coastal-team, #coastal-random, Moss's Coastal digests and your Pellucid cutover note.

PELLUCID HARBOR LOGISTICS (Gulf Coast)
- Ticket #4419: the Yard_Dwell_Summary report times out when filtered by container length. Open (Coastal cheat sheet).
- Ticket #PD-8841: chassis pool holds on double-booked gates, with screenshots from Gate 4B. Raised by night dispatcher Hector (your 12/8/25 cutover recap). I can't see a status.
- No ticket number: chassis pool validation at Gate 4 during shift change is called the main friction point (cheat sheet).
- No ticket number: a CSV import bug on the Berth 2 yard map was still lingering at cutover (your recap).

DRIFTMOOR MARINE FREIGHT (Puget Sound)
- Feature request #882: a bulk-clear button for departed barges, requested by warehouse managers (cheat sheet).
- Ticket #4419: barge slip 7 schedule sync. The patched manifest CSV was requested before the 06:00 shift (Moss's 11/2/25 digest).
- No ticket number: the tide-table import macro failed on Terminal B. Engineering gave the night dispatcher a manual CSV patch (cheat sheet).

Check before the review: #4419 appears under both accounts with different subjects. Moss's 11/2 digest attributes it to Kwame's port account (Driftmoor), and the cheat sheet puts it on Pellucid. One of them is probably a typo, but I can't tell which from what I can see. Please confirm in the ticketing system.

Left out: Pellow Home Living, formerly Covey & Lark (PD-4821, #8812). The PHL code is shared, so I checked each item against the account name or the Gulf Coast terminal context. I found nothing in the channels on either account beyond the above, and Moss's notes don't give ticket statuses or dates for most items.
